descripcion: High-efficiency inorganic coagulant used in the clarification of drinking, waste, and industrial water. It promotes the destabilization of colloids and the formation of flocs with lower alkalinity consumption than conventional coagulants, which is associated with lower sludge volumes. Its performance is adjusted through jar testing according to the quality of the water to be treated.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on batch availability

descripcion: Traditional inorganic coagulant for the clarification of water and effluents. It promotes the agglomeration of suspended particles and colloids for subsequent sedimentation or filtration. It is also used as a fixing mordant in textiles and tanning, and in other cosmetic, cleaning and veterinary applications depending on the formulation and applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — granules, lumps or powder, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: High-molecular-weight polymeric flocculant with an anionic charge, used as a coagulation aid in solid-liquid separation. It accelerates floc sedimentation and improves the clarity of treated water in combination with inorganic coagulants. Grade selection is carried out through testing according to the type of solid to be removed.
aplicaciones: Clarification of raw water and wastewater
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or micro-beads, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Polymeric flocculant with a cationic charge, especially used in the conditioning and dewatering of organic sludge. It neutralizes the surface charges of biological solids and facilitates the formation of flocs resistant to mechanical shear in filter presses, centrifuges, and belt presses. It is dosed as a diluted solution prepared on site.
aplicaciones: Clarification of water with organic load
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or micro-beads, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — emulsion, depending on batch availability

descripcion: Formulation based on phosphonates and dispersant polymers used to inhibit the formation of mineral scale on reverse osmosis membranes and heat exchange equipment. It helps extend operating cycles between cleanings and protect the service life of the membranes. The dosage is defined according to the analysis of the feed water.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Solid source of available chlorine used in the disinfection of water and surfaces. It offers greater storage stability than liquid chlorine solutions, which makes it practical for remote plants and swimming pools. Its use in contact with food or drinking water must comply with the applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — granules, powder, or tablets, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Reducing agent used as a decolorizing agent and for the removal of residual chlorine from water upstream of reverse osmosis membranes. It is also used as an oxygen scavenger in boiler circuits and as a reducing auxiliary in textile processes. In food applications, its use must comply with the applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Food preservation in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on batch availability

descripcion: Iron-based inorganic coagulant with high colloid-destabilizing power and phosphorus removal capacity in wastewater. It is also used for sulfide and odor control in sewer networks. Its dosage is optimized through jar testing according to the effluent to be treated.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch
Solid — crystals or lumps, depending on batch availability

descripcion: Polyphosphate with sequestering and dispersing properties used for hardness and scale control in water systems. It acts as a deflocculant in mineral suspensions and as a stabilizer in various industrial formulations. In food applications, its use must comply with the applicable regulations.
aplicaciones: Food additive in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, granules, or plates, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble nonionic cellulosic thickener, standard in water-based architectural paints for viscosity control, water retention and storage stability. It provides good leveling and spatter resistance during application. It is also used as a rheology modifier in cleaning gels, personal care products and topical veterinary products.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Low-molecular-weight acrylic polymer used as a dispersant for pigments and mineral fillers in water-based paints. It reduces grinding viscosity and improves dispersion stability, which is associated with better color development and less settling. It also acts as a scale inhibitor in water circuits.
aplicaciones: Grinding of calcium carbonate and kaolin
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Defoaming formulation based on mineral oil with hydrophobic particles, designed for foam control in the manufacture and application of water-based paints. It acts both in the grinding stage and during filling, helping to reduce film defects such as craters and microbubbles. Compatibility testing is recommended for each formulation.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — opaque fluid, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Slow-evaporating coalescing agent used in water-based architectural paints to promote film formation at low temperatures. It temporarily plasticizes the emulsion particles, improving film integrity, gloss, and scrub resistance. Its efficiency allows moderate dosages in most acrylic and vinyl systems.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Widely used mineral filler serving as a pigment extender in paints, putties, and plastics. It provides body, dry hiding power, and cost control in the formulation. The available particle size varies by manufacturer and is confirmed in the technical data sheet (TDS) of the batch.
aplicaciones: Food additive in accordance with regulations
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, variable particle size depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Fast-evaporating polar solvent, widely used in surface cleaning, electronics, and industrial processes. It is the base of disinfectant formulations and equipment cleaning products due to its miscibility with water and low residue. It is also used as a diluent in inks and coatings.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Fast-evaporating ester solvent with high dissolving power for resins, inks, and adhesives. It is a standard component of thinners for nitrocellulose lacquers and for flexographic and rotogravure printing inks. Its handling is subject to the controls applicable to controlled substances in Colombia.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Medium-evaporating ester solvent, valued in coatings for improving leveling and reducing moisture blushing in lacquers. It efficiently dissolves nitrocellulose, acrylic, and polyurethane resins. A common component of thinners for wood finishes and automotive refinishing.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Glycol for industrial use employed as a base for coolant and antifreeze fluids, and as an intermediate in the manufacture of polyester resins. In water-based paints it acts as an aid for freeze-thaw stability. It is not suitable for food contact; its use in household care or personal care must be evaluated and verified in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Versatile glycol used as a solvent, humectant and vehicle in multiple industries. In the industrial segment it serves as a base for low-toxicity heat transfer fluids and as an intermediate in resins; food-grade, personal care, pharmaceutical and nutraceutical grades are allocated in accordance with applicable regulations. Its safety profile makes it preferred over other glycols in sensitive applications.
aplicaciones: Vehicle in pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulations
formas_referenciales: Liquid — depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Higher-boiling glycol used as a slow-drying solvent, plasticizer, and wetting agent in strictly industrial applications. It is used in the manufacture of resins, inks, and textile auxiliaries, and as a gas dehydrating agent in the oil industry. It must not be used in food, pharmaceutical, or personal care applications.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Glycol ether with good coupling power between water and organic solvents, used as a solvent and coupling agent in aqueous formulations. It is a classic component of degreasers and all-purpose cleaners, and acts as a coalescing solvent in water-based coatings. Its use in cosmetics and veterinary products is subject to restrictions, so the applicable regulations are verified.
aplicaciones: Solvent in cosmetic and veterinary formulations, according to regulations
formas_referenciales: Liquid — depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Anionic surfactant with high wetting power and low surface tension, used as a rapid wetting agent in textile preparation and dyeing processes. It facilitates the uniform penetration of aqueous baths into hard-to-wet substrates. It is also used as a wetting agent in agricultural formulations and industrial dispersions.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — solution, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Silicone emulsion with amino-functional groups used as a finishing softener for textiles. It provides a soft, silky hand feel, improves fabric elasticity, and facilitates sewing and ironing. It is applied by exhaustion or padding in the finishing stage depending on the substrate.
aplicaciones: Finishing of cotton fabrics and blends
formas_referenciales: Liquid — emulsion, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Formulation based on polydimethylsiloxane and hydrophobic silica for foam control in aqueous processes. It acts at low doses by breaking existing foam and preventing its re-formation, with good persistence in systems with intense agitation. Compatibility with temperature and pH, and the suitable grade for cosmetic, pharmaceutical or veterinary processes, are verified for each application.
aplicaciones: Foam control in cosmetic and pharmaceutical production
formas_referenciales: Liquid — emulsion or compound, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Solid acid that is safer to handle than liquid mineral acids, used as a descaler for scale, oxides, and calcareous deposits on equipment and facilities. It is the base of acid cleaners for boilers, heat exchangers, coils, and sanitary surfaces. Its controlled action reduces the risk of excessive attack on metals compared with other strong acids.
aplicaciones: Chemical cleaning of boilers and heat exchangers
Equipment cleaning in the beverage industry
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or crystals, depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: General-purpose alkali for raising and adjusting pH in industrial processes and water treatment. In textiles, it is a classic fixation auxiliary in dyeing with reactive dyes, and in detergency it acts as an alkalinity builder. Its versatility makes it an inventory staple across multiple industries.
aplicaciones: pH adjustment in water and effluents
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules, depending on the manufacturer and batch
